About Me

A Bit About Me 👨🏻
Intro
Hey! I'm Akshay — a protocol engineer who's equally obsessed with blockchain, AI, and full-stack challenges. Late nights are reserved for diving into decentralized systems, training RL agents, or reading another paper on game theory.

Since Dec 2022, I've been at Powerloom Protocol shipping real infrastructure: co-designed V1→V2→DSV architecture, authored Snapshotter node contracts that raised ~800 ETH, built $POWER tokenomics and mainnet on Arbitrum Nitro, shipped gasless EIP-712 relayers, Onchain Points + Generative Prediction Markets, ran three incentivized testnets with partners like CoinList, Polygon zkEVM, and Socket — and single-handedly launched BDS, our production decentralized data market streaming real-time Uniswap data with 1-click IPFS proofs (built for agentic AI from day one).

In 2024, I moved to Bangalore to help spin up and lead Powerloom's engineering hub — loving the energy (and the filter coffee).

When I'm not deep in code, you'll find me trading, at a hackathon, or reminiscing about my Google Summer of Code days. Always happy to geek out on protocols, data markets, ZK, or AI agents — reach me at xadahiya[at]gmail.com!
My Interests & Past 👨🏻‍💻
Summary
Blockchain Engineering

Deployed 70+ audited smart contracts across major EVM chains. From Play2Earn games and MEV-resistant vaults to custom oracles and cross-chain bridges — I've built the full spectrum. The past three years have been dedicated to Powerloom, where I'm helping build the decentralized data layer that makes on-chain data fast, provable, and agent-ready. Still writing Solidity at 4 a.m. because that's when the best ideas hit.

Full-Stack & Beyond

Started as a Graduate Programmer at Fidelity International, building Django + React tools for portfolio managers handling real capital. Went deep into AI at Georgia Tech, then shipped production ML at Hypersonix. Mentored hundreds of Udacity students in Deep Learning, React, and Full Stack development — and watched them grow from zero to deployed. Google Summer of Code admin and mentor for Hydra Ecosystem across four years. Been navigating the intersection of AI, blockchain, and full-stack since 2016 — still can't pick just one lane.

AI & Machine Learning

Self-taught through MIT OCW, Georgia Tech OMSCS, and Udacity nanodegrees — covering AI, ML, RL, and Computer Vision. Master's from Georgia Tech was a deep dive into applied ML. Built production systems with PyTorch and TensorFlow at Hypersonix, developed counter-plagiarism AI that Georgia Tech still runs, and published peer-reviewed papers. PPO agents, GANs, YOLO, SLAM — I still spin them up when the itch needs scratching.

Academic Research

Worked under Dr. Thad Starner (a pioneer in wearable computing). Built Examinator — an AI system that detects academic dishonesty using Gradescope metrics, improving detection accuracy from ~15% to 25%. Shipped JackMarker + GitDown to trace and remove leaked solutions across the web. Published two ACM Learning@Scale papers; covered by Forbes and Times Higher Education. Georgia Tech still runs parts of the system in production. That felt pretty good.

Open Source & Hackathons

Google Summer of Code admin and mentor for Hydra Ecosystem (Linked Data for APIs) — four years growing the community and shipping Python tooling that lasted. Mentored and judged 5+ ETHGlobal hackathons — watched teams go from idea to mainnet deployment in 36 hours. Regular Hacktoberfest contributor; lost count of hackathon wins. These days, Powerloom is my open-source focus — decentralized data markets built for agents, running in production, streaming Uniswap data sub-second with IPFS proofs. Still merging PRs at 3 a.m. because that's when the internet is quietest.
